# Video test fixtures (tasks #79, #84)

Tiny committed clips for the poster/metadata probes (`mf_poster.rs` tests) and the
FFmpeg producer/poster (`ffmpeg/` tests, `--features ffvideo`). All lavfi-generated
(no provenance/licensing exposure). The **Windows (MF) tests use H.264 only** — in
the box on every supported Windows; codec-extension formats (HEVC/AV1) are exercised
by the opt-in corpus there. The **FFmpeg tests also use the VP8/VP9/MKV fixtures
below** — those decoders are built into every FFmpeg, so committing them is safe.

## black_then_color.mp4

64×64 @ 30 fps, ~1 s, H.264 yuv420p, no audio: ~12 black frames then solid orange —
exercises the first-non-black mean-luma walk (the poster must skip the lead-in).

Regen:

```sh
ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=black:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=0.4" \
       -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=0.6" \
       -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0" \
       -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 30 black_then_color.mp4
```

## color_with_tone.mp4

64×64 @ 30 fps, 1 s, H.264 + a 440 Hz AAC tone — exercises `has_audio` detection
(the producer's `Opened` event, phase 5's start-the-audio-player signal).

Regen:

```sh
ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=1" \
       -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" \
       -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 30 -c:a aac -b:a 32k -shortest color_with_tone.mp4
```

## color_vp9.webm / color_vp8.webm (task #84)

64×64 @ 30 fps, 1 s, solid orange, VP9 / VP8 in WebM, no audio — the macOS-fallback
flagship formats (AVFoundation can't demux WebM or decode VP8/VP9) through the FFmpeg
producer end-to-end.

Regen:

```sh
ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=1" \
       -c:v libvpx-vp9 -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 50k color_vp9.webm
ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=1" \
       -c:v libvpx -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 50k color_vp8.webm
```

## black_then_color.mkv (task #84)

The `black_then_color.mp4` content re-muxed as H.264-in-Matroska — the "MKV commonly
wraps H.264" case AVFoundation can't demux. Same poster-walk contract as the mp4.

Regen: the `black_then_color.mp4` command with an `.mkv` output name.

## rotated90.mp4 (task #84)

64×32 @ 30 fps, 1 s, orange, H.264 with a 90° display-matrix — the FFmpeg
producer/poster must emit upright 32×64 frames (rotation applied post-scale).

Regen:

```sh
ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x32:rate=30:duration=1" \
       -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 30 /tmp/src.mp4
ffmpeg -y -display_rotation 90 -i /tmp/src.mp4 -c copy rotated90.mp4
```

## multitrack.mkv / multitrack.mp4 (task #98)

The media-track catalog fixtures — one file per *backend*, because the two backends
honestly enumerate differently (see `.taskmaster/docs/98-phase0-spike-findings.md`).

**`multitrack.mkv`** (~20 KB) is the FFmpeg reference: 64×64 H.264 + **2 audio** (AAC
stereo `eng` *default*; AC-3 5.1 `fra` titled "Director's Commentary" with the `comment`
disposition — the commentary-by-title *and* by-disposition case) + **4 subtitles** (SubRip
`eng` *default*; SubRip `eng` *forced+hearing_impaired* titled "English SDH"; a **bitmap
PGS** track `spa`; SubRip `jpn` titled "日本語字幕" — non-Latin title *and* language).

**`multitrack.mp4`** (~13 KB) is the AVFoundation fixture: 2 AAC tracks (`eng` default /
`fra`) + 2 tx3g subtitle tracks (`eng` default / `fra` forced). AVFoundation expands those
2 subtitle tracks into **4** legible options (it synthesizes forced-only variants) — the
tests assert that, since it is what the backend really reports.

> **The PGS track is hand-built.** FFmpeg has no PGS encoder and refuses text→bitmap
> subtitle transcoding, so `bitmap.sup` is generated by a small script that emits the raw
> HDMV Presentation Graphic Stream segments (PCS/WDS/PDS/ODS/END, then a clearing display
> set) for one 8×8 opaque square, and muxed with `-c:s copy`. FFmpeg's `sup` demuxer reads
> it back as a genuine `hdmv_pgs_subtitle` stream.

Regen:

```sh
printf '1\n00:00:00,100 --> 00:00:00,900\nHello\n'        > eng.srt
printf '1\n00:00:00,100 --> 00:00:00,900\n[door creaks]\n' > sdh.srt
printf '1\n00:00:00,100 --> 00:00:00,900\nこんにちは\n'      > jpn.srt

# bitmap.sup — a minimal one-cue PGS stream (no FFmpeg encoder exists for this).
python3 - > bitmap.sup <<'PY'
import struct, sys
def seg(pts, typ, payload):
    return b"PG" + struct.pack(">IIB H", pts, 0, typ, len(payload)) + payload
def rle_solid(w, h, color):
    out = b""
    for _ in range(h):
        n = w
        while n > 0:
            run = min(n, 63); out += bytes([0x00, 0x80 | run, color]); n -= run
        out += b"\x00\x00"          # end of line
    return out
W = H = 64; OW = OH = 8
start, end = int(0.1 * 90000), int(0.9 * 90000)
pcs = lambda num, state, objs: struct.pack(">HHBHBBBB", W, H, 0x10, num, state, 0, 0, len(objs)) + \
      b"".join(struct.pack(">HBBHH", o, w, 0, x, y) for (o, w, x, y) in objs)
data = struct.pack(">HH", OW, OH) + rle_solid(OW, OH, 1)
out  = seg(start, 0x16, pcs(0, 0x80, [(0, 0, 28, 28)]))
out += seg(start, 0x17, struct.pack(">BBHHHH", 1, 0, 28, 28, OW, OH))
out += seg(start, 0x14, struct.pack(">BB", 0, 0) + struct.pack(">BBBBB", 1, 235, 128, 128, 255))
out += seg(start, 0x15, struct.pack(">HBB", 0, 0, 0xC0) + len(data).to_bytes(3, "big") + data)
out += seg(start, 0x80, b"") + seg(end, 0x16, pcs(1, 0x00, [])) + seg(end, 0x80, b"")
sys.stdout.buffer.write(out)
PY

ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=1" \
  -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" \
  -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=220:duration=1:sample_rate=48000" \
  -i eng.srt -i sdh.srt -i bitmap.sup -i jpn.srt \
  -map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -map 3:s -map 4:s -map 5:s -map 6:s \
  -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 40 \
  -c:a:0 aac -b:a:0 32k -ac:a:0 2 -c:a:1 ac3 -b:a:1 96k -ac:a:1 6 \
  -c:s:0 subrip -c:s:1 subrip -c:s:2 copy -c:s:3 subrip \
  -metadata:s:a:0 language=eng -disposition:a:0 default \
  -metadata:s:a:1 language=fra -metadata:s:a:1 "title=Director's Commentary" -disposition:a:1 comment \
  -metadata:s:s:0 language=eng -disposition:s:0 default \
  -metadata:s:s:1 language=eng -metadata:s:s:1 "title=English SDH" -disposition:s:1 forced+hearing_impaired \
  -metadata:s:s:2 language=spa \
  -metadata:s:s:3 language=jpn -metadata:s:s:3 "title=日本語字幕" \
  -t 1 multitrack.mkv

ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=1" \
  -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=220:duration=1" \
  -i eng.srt -i sdh.srt \
  -map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -map 3:s -map 4:s \
  -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 40 -c:a aac -b:a 32k -ac 2 -c:s mov_text \
  -metadata:s:a:0 language=eng -disposition:a:0 default \
  -metadata:s:a:1 language=fra -disposition:a:1 comment \
  -metadata:s:s:0 language=eng -disposition:s:0 default \
  -metadata:s:s:1 language=fra -disposition:s:1 forced \
  -tag:v avc1 -t 1 multitrack.mp4
```

## hdr_pq.mp4 (task #84)

64×64 @ 30 fps, 1 s, orange, HEVC 10-bit PQ (smpte2084 / bt2020 / bt2020nc) — the
FFmpeg fp16 HDR path (plan §9): frames must leave as scene-linear scRGB Rgba16F,
never tone-mapped RGBA8.

Regen:

```sh
ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=orange:size=64x64:rate=30:duration=1" \
       -c:v libx265 -pix_fmt yuv420p10le \
       -x265-params "colorprim=bt2020:transfer=smpte2084:colormatrix=bt2020nc" \
       -tag:v hvc1 hdr_pq.mp4
```
